items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 2 May 2026 11:47am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Largely cloudy and mainly dry this afternoon, before outbreaks of rain develop for the evening. Light south or southwest wind and a maximum temperature of 13°C. Outbreaks of persistent rain continue overnight.

Cloudy tomorrow with some outbreaks of rain during the morning, this tending to gradually peter out in the afternoon with bright or sunny intervals developing. Light to moderate north or northeast wind and a top temperature of 15°C.


##Outlook##

Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells on Monday. Light to moderate north or northwest wind and a highest temperature of 14°C.
